blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings at the Paso Robles estate tasting room with vineyard views and dog-friendly patios, or at the Laguna Beach tasting room with ocean views and an intimate setting. The winery offers wine club memberships with various shipment options and discounts. Lodging is available at the Vineyard House, a 3-bedroom home on the estate overlooking a lake.
